commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; cd projects/kobra2-neo; PLOTTER="$HOME/.local/share/plotter-tools/plottter/.venv/bin/plottter"; test -x "$PLOTTER"; uv sync --frozen >/dev/null; BASE="$HOME/Desktop/kamienna110-map-beauty-150"; PROFILE="${BASE}-profile.toml"; cat > "$PROFILE" <<'TOML'
schema_version = 1
name = "kobra2-neo-pen-beauty-150"

[workspace]
min_x = 45.0
max_x = 181.0
min_y = 65.0
max_y = 201.0
margin = 0.0

[motion]
travel_feed = 3000.0
draw_feed = 1200.0
z_feed = 180.0

[orientation]
swap_xy = false
flip_x = false
flip_y = true

[tool]
pen_up_z = 6.12
pen_down_z = 2.97

[sequence]
end = ["M400"]
TOML
for R in 0.45 0.55 0.65; do TAG=$(printf '%s' "$R" | tr '.' 'p'); SVG="${BASE}-r${TAG}.svg"; JOB="${BASE}-r${TAG}.job"; rm -f "$SVG"; if [ -d "$JOB" ]; then test -f "$JOB/.kobra-plot-job" && rm -rf "$JOB" || { echo "REFUSING_UNMARKED_JOB:$JOB"; exit 40; }; fi; echo "=== GENERATE radius=$R ==="; "$PLOTTER" --generator Map --preset "Full City" --paper Custom --width 150 --height 150 --margin 7 --param 'location=Kamienna 110, Wroclaw, Poland' --param radius_km=$R --param extent_mode=radius --param road_detail=all_streets --param include_roads=true --param include_rail=true --param include_water=true --param include_waterways=true --param include_parks=true --param include_buildings=true --param include_coastline=false --param area_fill=none --param major_road_strokes=1 --param simplify_mm=0.12 --param min_feature_mm=0.8 --param include_attribution=false --param include_water_labels=false --param include_park_labels=false --param include_place_labels=false --param include_waterway_labels=false --param include_road_labels=false --format svg --no-registration-marks --output "$SVG"; test -s "$SVG"; uv run kobra-plot prepare "$SVG" --profile "$PROFILE" -o "$JOB"; done; uv run python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib
base=Path.home()/"Desktop/kamienna110-map-beauty-150"
cands=[]
for radius,tag in [(0.45,'0p45'),(0.55,'0p55'),(0.65,'0p65')]:
    job=Path(f'{base}-r{tag}.job')
    rep=json.loads((job/'report.json').read_text())
    g=rep['geometry']; s=rep['safety']
    if not s.get('valid'):
        raise SystemExit(f'candidate {radius} failed safety')
    c={'radius':radius,'tag':tag,'job':job,'time':float(g['nominal_time_seconds']),'polylines':int(g['polylines']),'points':int(g['points']),'draw':float(g['draw_distance_mm']),'travel':float(g['travel_distance_mm']),'bounds':g['output_bounds']}
    cands.append(c)
    print('CANDIDATE',json.dumps({k:v for k,v in c.items() if k!='job'},sort_keys=True))
preferred=next(c for c in cands if c['radius']==0.55)
if preferred['time'] <= 3300 and preferred['polylines'] <= 1400:
    chosen=preferred
else:
    feasible=[c for c in cands if c['time']<=3300 and c['polylines']<=1400]
    chosen=min(feasible,key=lambda c:abs(c['radius']-0.55)) if feasible else min(cands,key=lambda c:c['time'])
print('CHOSEN',json.dumps({k:v for k,v in chosen.items() if k!='job'},sort_keys=True))
job=chosen['job']
for srcname,dst in [('output.gcode',f'{base}-kobra.gcode'),('preview.svg',f'{base}-kobra-preview.svg'),('report.json',f'{base}-kobra-report.json')]:
    shutil.copy2(job/srcname,Path(dst))
shutil.copy2(Path(f'{base}-r{chosen["tag"]}.svg'),Path(f'{base}.svg'))
sel={'selected_radius_km':chosen['radius'],'selection_reason':'prefer 0.55 km resolution sweet spot when runtime/lift count remain bounded; otherwise nearest feasible candidate','geometry':{k:v for k,v in chosen.items() if k not in {'job','tag'}},'gcode_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(f'{base}-kobra.gcode').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
Path(f'{base}-selection.json').write_text(json.dumps(sel,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print('FINAL_SELECTION',json.dumps(sel,sort_keys=True))
PY
FINAL_G="${BASE}-kobra.gcode"; FINAL_R="${BASE}-kobra-report.json"; SHA=$(shasum -a 256 "$FINAL_G" | awk '{print $1}'); echo "FINAL_SHA256=$SHA"; uv run kobra-live "$FINAL_G" --report "$FINAL_R" --profile "$PROFILE" --expect-sha256 "$SHA" --validate-only; PORT=$(uv run python - <<'PY'
import glob
from kobra_live import PosixSerial,_identify
for p in sorted(glob.glob('/dev/cu.usbserial-*')):
    try:
        with PosixSerial(p) as s:
            _identify(s)
        print(p)
        break
    except Exception:
        pass
PY
); test -n "$PORT"; echo "KOBRA_PORT=$PORT"; set +e; uv run kobra-live "$FINAL_G" --report "$FINAL_R" --profile "$PROFILE" --port "$PORT" --expect-sha256 "$SHA" --progress-every 100 --thermal-check-every 250 > "${BASE}-live.log" 2>&1; RC=$?; set -e; cat "${BASE}-live.log"; if [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]; then echo "RESULT:PRINT_COMPLETED"; elif grep -q 'hotend thermal monitor implausible' "${BASE}-live.log"; then echo "RESULT:PRINT_BLOCKED_THERMISTOR_BEFORE_MOTION"; else echo "RESULT:PRINT_FAILED_UNEXPECTED rc=$RC"; exit "$RC"; fi; echo '=== FINAL FILES ==='; ls -lh "${BASE}.svg" "$FINAL_G" "${BASE}-kobra-preview.svg" "$FINAL_R" "$PROFILE" "${BASE}-selection.json"; echo BEAUTY_MAP_AUTONOMOUS_FLOW_DONE
